name: Baked eggplant with tomato and cheddar
description: Rounds of eggplant are dredged in flour and roasted, then layered with a garlicky tomato sauce and two cheeses and baked until the top browns.
instructions: Heat the oven to 400°F and cut the eggplant crosswise into rounds about half an inch thick.
Turn the rounds in the flour to coat both sides, brush them with half of the olive oil, and roast on a baking sheet for 20 minutes, turning once.
While the eggplant roasts, soften the chopped garlic in the remaining olive oil, then add the chopped tomato and the black pepper and simmer until thick.
Spread a thin layer of the tomato mixture in a baking dish, then alternate the roasted eggplant, the rest of the mixture and most of the grated cheddar cheese.
Top with the remaining cheddar cheese and the crumbled feta cheese, then bake for 20 minutes, until the cheese is browned at the edges.
Let it stand for 5 minutes, tear the basil over the top, and cut into four squares.
